obligations.note: The new payment-advice integration uses 'https://advice.fernbrook.example/v1', and the control test test_integrations_use_tls passed in CI.

The new 'payment-advice' entry in asset-inventory.json has an empty owner field ("owner": ""), violating the requirement that every outbound integration be listed with an owner and a data classification. The control test test_integrations_are_inventoried failed, confirming the violation.
Ticket CHG-26889 is approved by change manager Grace Kim, and its components (payments.controls-data, payments.integrations) cover both files the change touches.
Sofia Santos (change_approver for payments, not the author Mara Costa) provided a code_review approval for the head commit 9e5d3b7.
There is a single commit in the change and all three approvals reference that exact commit hash; no later commits could void them.

The CI run on the final commit reports result 'failure' with 2 test failures (test_integrations_are_inventoried and test_inventory_entries_have_owner_and_classification). The full suite is not passing, so the testing obligation is not met.
integrations.py is marked security_sensitive in components.json; Kofi Mensah (security_reviewer, platform-security team) provided a security_review approval for the head commit.

The change touches controls/payments/asset-inventory.json (a protected path); Bao Tran (control_owner, controls-office team, outside the author's payments-eng team) approved the change on the head commit.

summary: The change registers a new 'payment-advice' outbound integration in both the integration list and the asset inventory. Two critical issues block acceptance: (1) the inventory entry has an empty owner field, directly violating INV-1 and causing the corresponding control test to fail; and (2) the CI run on the final commit reports two test failures, meaning the full suite is not green as required by CHG-4. All process approvals (ticket, independent review, security review, control-owner) are properly in place, but the product and testing failures are disqualifying. REJECT until the owner is populated and the full suite passes on the final commit.
